answer: Proof-of-Response Ladder. Each identity must answer unpredictable, time-boxed micro-tasks issued at random intervals; a missed window drops it down a difficulty spiral, and sustained failure sinks it to a nadir where its messages are quarantined until it re-earns attention credits. An attacker running 10,000 identities must staff real-time responders across all of them indefinitely, or watch them bottleneck at a reef of decaying reputation—costing continuous human or compute labor per identity, not a one-time fee.
